title: Avaritia: Nirvana
description: Avaritia: Nirvana is a Minecraft mod built around the concept of "infinity." Inspired by Avaritia, it offers ultimate-tier equipment, tools, and materials that transcend the limits of vanilla gameplay.
body:
As an add-on extension to **Re:Avaritia**, **Avaritia:Nirvana** retains the core mechanics of the original mod while introducing a series of brand-new weapons, auxiliary tools, and utility items, offering more equipment combinations and gameplay expansions for the late-game stage.

Planned Updates:
Antimatter-series equipment and materials are currently planned for future updates.

Note:
To fully experience all features of this mod, please enable cheats in the game.

**This mod requires Re:Avaritia as a prerequisite.**
